ONGC CSR Funds Donated to Sangh-Linked Organizations

State-owned Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) donated over Rs 668 crore to 20 organizations linked to the Sangh Parivar over a period of 10 to 12 years. This information was reported by The News Minute and National Herald. The donations were made from ONGC's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funds. The Pioneer reported that the Congress party alleged these funds were routed to RSS-linked organizations.
